sections.title: The work is good. Keeping track of it is the problem.

items.title: Every question comes back to you
items.body: Where is that quote? Did anyone call them back? The answer lives in your head, so the team waits on you.

items.title: Four dashboards, no answer
items.body: The CRM, the calendar, the inbox and the invoices each hold part of the story, and none of them agree.

items.title: Leads go cold while you are on the job
items.body: A new enquiry arrives while you are with a customer. By the time you call back, they have hired someone else.

items.title: Follow-up lives in your head
items.body: Quotes, callbacks and reminders sit in your inbox, your texts and a notebook. Nothing chases them unless you do.

items.title: Tools nobody uses
items.body: Another app with another login. It was supposed to save time and became one more thing to manage.

sections.title: One operating view, four sections
sections.lede: Every plan runs on the same Command Center. The difference is who sets it up and who runs it with you.

items.title: Team
items.body: Who owns what, and what is waiting on whom, across your people and the AI agents working beside them.

items.title: Growth
items.body: New leads, where they came from and the next follow-up, in one pipeline instead of four inboxes.

items.title: Clients
items.body: Each client's work, conversations and next steps in one place, so nobody has to ask you.

items.title: Money
items.body: Overview and analytics, transactions, invoices, bills and expenses, accounts, reports and taxes, next to the work that earned it.

items.q: What happens on the discovery call?
items.a: It is a video call. You talk first: how leads come in, where they stall and what a good week looks like. Then you see the Command Center and how it would fit your business. If it is not a fit, you will hear that too.

items.q: Which plan is right for me?
items.a: If you are comfortable configuring software, OS DIY. If you would rather hand it over, OS Turnkey. If you want a team running it alongside you every week, the managed operating partner. You get a recommendation on the call.

items.q: What do you need from me to get started?
items.a: For Turnkey and Managed, the onboarding vault: you add the logins, sign the documents and choose your channels in one place. Setup starts when it is complete.

items.q: What if the setup fee is too much right now?
items.a: Turnkey's setup can be split into two payments. You can also start on OS DIY with no setup fee, or join the free OASIS community and build alongside other owners first.
Cancel any time from your account. There is no cancellation fee.

brief.audience: Service businesses doing about $10K-75K a month (oasis-ai.md pillar 2, cat=p2): DIY for tech-fluent SMBs, Turnkey for service SMBs, Managed for established businesses.
brief.promise: One place to run the company and the agents inside it (pack v2 command film, CC-approved).
brief.included: 2A OS DIY, 2B OS Turnkey (onboarding vault, setup starts when it is complete), 2C Managed operating partner (dedicated fleet ops + weekly audit). Product truth: Team, Growth, Clients and Money are first-class sections; Money holds overview, analytics, transactions, invoices, bills and expenses, accounts, reports, taxes and settings.
brief.price: Recommended USD: DIY $497/mo no setup; Turnkey $997/mo + $2,500 setup (or 2 x $1,400); Managed $3,000/mo + $5,000 setup. CC confirms each tier in the builder.
brief.bonuses: Expedited VIP vault bonus at the close of the discovery call. The funnel doc's $500 value stays hidden until CC confirms it.
brief.guarantee: None on the page. The handover's 7-day turnkey SLA is described as a setup clock, not a guarantee, until CC confirms terms.
